broadcastIds.description: Paste broadcast links such as https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1YGNrbPLejQGw, broadcast IDs, or a post link whose card contains a broadcast. The actor finds the broadcast automatically.
broadcastIds.title: Broadcast links, IDs or broadcast posts

includeReplayVideo.description: Include the HLS replay video link for broadcasts that have a replay.
includeReplayVideo.title: Include replay video link

includeThumbnail.description: Include the broadcast thumbnail/cover image URL. Turn off for a lighter output.
includeThumbnail.title: Include thumbnail image

includeViewerStats.description: Include current viewers, total viewers and the viewer history graph. Turn off for a lighter output.
includeViewerStats.title: Include viewer statistics

includeViewerTimeline.description: Push one "viewer timeline point" row per point of the broadcast's viewer history graph (viewers, point index and a timestamp derived from the broadcast's real start/end time). No rows are emitted when X provides no graph.
includeViewerTimeline.title: Emit viewer timeline points as rows

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if you plan large runs or see frequent rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
